nodes.name: Get Page Access Token
nodes.notes: Calls GET /me/accounts using the connected user's OAuth2 token to list every Facebook Page this account administers, each with its own long-lived Page access token. A USER access token cannot post to a Page directly -- Graph API requires the Page's own access token from this list, extracted in the next node. Requires the 'pages_show_list' permission at minimum (granted) -- posting itself needs 'pages_manage_posts', which was NOT yet added/tested in Alan's Meta app as of 2026-07-27 (see docs/facebook-scheduled-post-workflow.md).

nodes.name: Extract Target Page Token
nodes.notes: Page ID confirmed live 2026-07-28 by executing 'Get Page Access Token' in n8n after OAuth connected: the account manages exactly one Page, 'Everythinginternet.ca' (id 1096244530243584) -- not a separate 'Axiom Enterprises' page as the original design doc assumed. Throws a clear error and stops the run if the Page isn't found, rather than silently posting nowhere or with the wrong token.

nodes.name: Get All Posts

nodes.name: Filter Ready To Post
nodes.notes: Known n8n import quirk (same as the LinkedIn build): this Filter node's Value fields sometimes need to be re-typed by hand in the UI even when the JSON looks correct -- open the node and confirm both conditions are actually populated before relying on it. Also verify how Google Sheets is actually returning scheduledDate (string vs. serial date).

nodes.name: Download Image File
nodes.notes: Reuse the same Google Drive credential already wired into the YouTube/LinkedIn workflows. Alan pastes the image's Drive file ID directly into the Sheet row, same pattern as the LinkedIn build.

nodes.name: Create Approval Draft (Gmail)

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Facebook Page post ready for review: ' + $('Filter Ready To Post').item.json.postText.substring(0, 60) }}
parameters.message:
={{ 'Post text:
' + $('Filter Ready To Post').item.json.postText + '

Scheduled for: ' + $('Filter Ready To Post').item.json.scheduledDate + '

Image: ' + ($('Filter Ready To Post').item.json.imageFileId ? ('Google Drive file ID ' + $('Filter Ready To Post').item.json.imageFileId) : 'no image') + '

Target Page: ' + $('Extract Target Page Token').first().json.pageName + ' (' + $('Extract Target Page Token').first().json.pageId + ')' + '

Guardian review already happened upstream at draft time (per repo convention -- see automation/content-log.md). This workflow no longer posts to Facebook automatically. Review this draft and, if approved, publish it to the Page yourself.' }}

nodes.notes: REPLACES the former 'Create Post With Image' and 'Create Text Only Post' Facebook Graph API nodes per Alan's 2026-08-02 decision (docs/decisions-log.md) -- this workflow no longer posts directly to Facebook. Single node handles both the has-image and no-image branches (Has Image? true -> Download Image File -> here; Has Image? false -> here directly). Judgment call: the draft references the image by its Drive file ID as text rather than attaching the actual binary, since 'Download Image File' output isn't guaranteed present on the no-image branch and the task only asked for 'a reference to the image (file ID or note no image)', not a live attachment -- flagging in case Alan would rather have the binary attached when available. Guardian review is assumed to have already happened at content-drafting time, same as every other content automation in this repo -- no in-workflow Guardian check was built here.

nodes.name: Update Row Status
nodes.notes: Changed 2026-08-02: status is now 'awaiting_approval' instead of 'posted', and postId/postUrl are left blank, since n8n no longer creates the live post -- Alan does, manually, after reviewing the Gmail draft. This still guards against re-processing the row on the next daily run (Filter Ready To Post only matches status == pending), matching the original re-post-guard intent. No longer reads $json.id / $json.post_id since there's no Graph API response to read from -- the 'Posted OK?' IF node that used to gate this is removed entirely.
